stage0007b_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
Mercenary
「This job's basically a diversion.
　Everyone, just take it easy out there.」

stage0007b_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
Mercenary
「What's that machine!
　It just showed up out of nowhere!」

stage0007b_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$n
「Too bad for you.
　There's no launch lag with the $$ジェニオン$$.」

stage0007b_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$スズネ$$
「How should I know!
　Why does getting into a robot
　mean showing this much skin!」

stage0007b_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「A-anyway!
　We need to deal with this first!」

stage0007b_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$n
「Since the Quarter will take time to arrive,
　we'll protect the city until then.」

stage0007b_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$スズネ$$
「From now on, we're partners in life and death!
　Don't call me 'Sensei', use my name!」

stage0007b_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
Mercenary
「We meant to lure out our targets,
　but hooked someone else instead.」

stage0007b_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
Mercenary
「Ah well.
　Guess we'll just mess around for now!」

stage0007b_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$n
（I'll do this alone...!
　This is the fight I chose...!）

stage0007b_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
Mercenary
「What's that machine!
　It just showed up out of nowhere!」

stage0007b_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$n
「Too bad for you.
　There's no launch lag with the $$ジェニオン$$.」

stage0007b_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:

「How should I know!
　Why does getting into a robot
　mean showing this much skin!」

stage0007b_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$スズネ$$
「A-anyway!

stage0007b_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$n
「Since the Quarter will take time to arrive,
　we'll protect the city until then.」

stage0007b_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:

「From now on, we're partners in life and death!
　Don't call me 'Sensei', use my name!」

stage0007b_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
Mercenary
「We meant to lure out our targets,
　but hooked someone else instead.」

stage0007b_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
Mercenary
「Ah well.
　Guess we'll just mess around for now!」

stage0007b_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$n
（I'll do this alone...!
　This is the fight I chose...!）

stage0007b_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n!
　I've confirmed a battleship-class approaching!」

stage0007b_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「No!
　Um... this is a Federation battleship!」

stage0007b_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$オットー$$
「Doesn't seem to be the unit we were chasing.」

stage0007b_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$レイアム$$
「But we can't just let this go.」

stage0007b_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$オットー$$
「I know!
　Give all units the order to attack!」

stage0007b_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$リディ$$
「$$カミーユ$$, we've got the signal to attack.」

stage0007b_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「They seem to be terrorists, after all.
　We can't just leave them be.」

stage0007b_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$リディ$$
「No need to hold back against them.」

stage0007b_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$エマ$$
「That blue robot looks like
　it's fighting the terrorists...」

stage0007b_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Attention, all units.
　That blue robot is said to belong
　to the Macross Quarter.」

stage0007b_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$カツ$$
「So that makes them our ally from now on, right?」

stage0007b_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$エマ$$
「$$ファ$$,
　go support that blue robot.」

stage0007b_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ファ$$
「This is $$ファ・ユイリィ$$ in the $$メタス$$.
　I'll cover you.」

stage0007b_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$n
「That's some unusual gear for the Federation...」

stage0007b_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$エマ$$
「This is Londo Bell of the Earth Federation Forces.
　We'll explain the details later,
　but we're on your side.」

stage0007b_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$エマ$$
「We'll be moving to intercept the terrorists too.」

stage0007b_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$オットー$$
「All units, begin your attack!
　Show the terrorists what Londo Bell can do!」

stage0007b_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Also, per Echoes' report from the scene,
　all pilots ejected and fled.」

stage0007b_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$オットー$$
「Echoes is pretty pathetic.
　Not one prisoner taken.」

stage0007b_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$レイアム$$
「It seems they'd secured escape routes
　and prepared thoroughly.」

stage0007b_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Captain, the Macross Quarter has arrived.」

stage0007b_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$オットー$$
「We're pursuing!
　Signal all units!」

stage0007b_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain, we have a different mission.
　Let's leave the rest to the Far East Branch.」

stage0007b_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$オットー$$
「R-right...
　We should get information on them
　from the pilots we captured.」

stage0007b_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Also, per Echoes' report from the scene,
　all pilots ejected and fled.」

stage0007b_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$オットー$$
「Echoes is pretty pathetic.
　Not one prisoner taken.」

stage0007b_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$レイアム$$
「It seems they'd secured escape routes
　and prepared thoroughly.」

stage0007b_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Captain, the Macross Quarter has arrived.」

stage0007b_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Tch... if it's already over,
　then what was the point of us coming?」

stage0007b_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Unlike some people who skipped out,
　$$宗介$$ and I were in the middle of a hike.」

stage0007b_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Even so, President.
　That's thanks to that Federation unit's efforts.」

stage0007b_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$n
「The Director's right about that.
　I'd have been in trouble alone.」

stage0007b_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That's right, $$ワッ太$$.
　And $$甲児$$ and the others stayed behind
　as patrol, so don't say things like that.」

stage0007b_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$さやか$$
「After today, we can't face $$正太郎$$ and the others...」

stage0007b_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$アルト$$
「Is that $$カミーユ$$ piloting
　that blue mobile suit?」

stage0007b_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's been a while.
　This unit's the $$リゼル$$...
　Anaheim's new model, which I'm testing.」

stage0007b_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$リディ$$
「Huh... old friends of $$カミーユ$$'s, so
　they used to be members of 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》?」

stage0007b_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Captain $$オットー$$,
　we have a channel open to the Macross Quarter.」

stage0007b_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Well then, Captain... go ahead.」

stage0007b_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$オットー$$
「Er, I'm Colonel $$オットー・ミタス$$ of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$,
　Londo Bell, an independent Earth Federation unit.」

stage0007b_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$オットー$$
「I imagine you've already been briefed on this,
　but this ship will be conducting a joint operation
　with you within the atmosphere.」

stage0007b_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This is Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$,
　captain of the Macross Quarter.
　I've already been informed of that.」

stage0007b_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Huh, their captain looks like
　some unreliable old guy.」

stage0007b_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ルカ$$
「But Londo Bell is supposed to be
　an elite Earth Federation unit.」

stage0007b_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$マオ$$
「Hold on...!
　Looks like we get to see what they're made of
　sooner than expected...!」

stage0007b_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Unidentified forces approaching this area!
　All units, stay alert!」

stage0007b_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「A $$ギラ・ドーガ$$, too...!
　So it's that Neo Zeon unit!」

stage0007b_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$さやか$$
「What is going on!?
　Isn't Neo Zeon part of the Earth Federation!」

stage0007b_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$クラン$$
「I can't believe they'd deploy forces
　in a place like this!」

stage0007b_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Is Neo Zeon staging an armed uprising
　against the Federation...!」

stage0007b_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They intend to strike at us.
　Put all units on combat footing.」

stage0007b_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「...He likes roundabout methods.
　Thanks to that, I had to come all the way to Earth.」

stage0007b_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「But if the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ is our opponent,
　that changes things.」

stage0007b_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This feeling...!
　That lead unit, custom-built for an Enhanced Human...!」

stage0007b_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$カミーユ・ビダン$$...!
　If you can feel my pressure,
　then you'll be my opponent!」

stage0007b_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain, Neo Zeon has entered attack formation.
　What are your orders?」

stage0007b_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$オットー$$
「Intercept them, of course!
　That's our mission!」

stage0007b_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$オットー$$
「Request the Quarter's support as well!」

stage0007b_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Here I come, Londo Bell!
　I'll show you the power of $$ギュネイ・ガス$$!」

stage0007b_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「The enemy forces have been wiped out.
　No reinforcements in sight.」

stage0007b_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Given this, it seems quite likely
　that Neo Zeon was involved behind the scenes
　in the earlier terrorist attack.」

stage0007b_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$オットー$$
「Damn Zeon...!
　So they've finally moved out into the open!」

stage0007b_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$レイアム$$
「But they never called themselves Neo Zeon.
　This might be the work of a group that stole
　Neo Zeon's mobile suits.」

stage0007b_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$レイアム$$
「As we're only the field unit,
　we'll have to leave this to command's judgment.」

stage0007b_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$オットー$$
「Y-yes...well.
　Then draft the report, please.」

stage0007b_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$キャシー$$
「...Will this incident become a decisive rift
　between Earth and space...?」

stage0007b_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Hard to say....
　If it's only this much, Neo Zeon
　can talk their way out of it easily enough.」

stage0007b_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What they want to know
　is how the Earth Federation will respond.」

stage0007b_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Hmm....
　The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ and we might have been
　played into Neo Zeon's provocation...」

stage0007b_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Tch...!
　I can't get used to this thing called gravity!」

stage0007b_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「No matter.
　My goal's achieved, so that's it for today.
　The real fight starts next time.」

stage0007b_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That guy... how does he know about me...?」

stage0007b_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（What is this... this unease keeps spreading...）

stage0007b_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That feeling....
　He's an Enhanced Human...」

stage0007b_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$エマ$$
「So Neo Zeon has Enhanced Humans too.」

stage0007b_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（What is this uneasy feeling...
　This unease keeps spreading...）

stage0007b_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Words... just flashed through my mind...?）

stage0007b_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（That feeling just now... Captain $$アムロ$$...?
　No, it felt more inexperienced...）

stage0007b_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Is there someone nearby who can sense me...）

stage0007b_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$n
「If you're scared, then step back.
　I'll fight alone.」

stage0007b_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$n
「No need to force yourself.
　It's always better not to fight, if you can help it.」

stage0007b_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm sorry, $n....
　I... wasn't prepared enough...」

stage0007b_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I... might hold you back...!
　But I will never run away!」

stage0007b_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$n
「...Understood.
　But I will protect Miss $$スズネ$$, no matter what...!」

stage0007b_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$リディ$$
「I'll leave the timing to you, $$カミーユ$$.
　You've got more combat experience and more time
　piloting variable mobile suits than I do.」

stage0007b_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then, with our two $$リゼル$$s in combination...!」

stage0007b_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$リディ$$
（This chance I've been given...!
　I'll make the most of it, no matter what!）

stage0007b_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$カツ$$
「I was only supposed to assist $$カミーユ$$,
　and now suddenly I'm in actual combat...!」

stage0007b_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$エマ$$
「You've come this far, so steel yourself, $$カツ$$!」

stage0007b_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$カツ$$
「I know!
　Whoever the enemy is, I'll show what I can do too!」

stage0007b_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$オットー$$
「We came down to Earth chasing Neo Zeon,
　and end up fighting terrorists instead...」

stage0007b_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain, give orders before you complain.」

stage0007b_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$オットー$$
「I know that!
　Londo Bell can't afford to fall behind
　some nameless terrorists!」

stage0007b_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$オットー$$
「Damn Neo Zeon...!
　Showing up right in the middle of Tokyo,
　is this a declaration of war!?」

stage0007b_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$レイアム$$
「I can't read their intent,
　but it's surely some kind of
　demonstration.」

stage0007b_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$オットー$$
「Then we can't afford to lose, even more so!
　For the honor of Londo Bell's name!」

stage0007b_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Pilot of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$!
　So you're $$カミーユ・ビダン$$!」

stage0007b_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This guy...!
　He knows about me!?」

stage0007b_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Bad luck for you!
　I'll defeat you and prove my strength!」

stage0007b_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I won't play along with your selfish logic!
　War isn't a game!」

stage0007b_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn Valkyrie...!
　Flying around so showily!」

stage0007b_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$アルト$$
「I don't know who you are,
　but if you start it, don't complain when you lose!」

stage0007b_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't make me laugh!
　Don't think the likes of you can take me down!」

stage0007b_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「So the $$ミスリル$$ I've heard rumors of
　is running joint ops with the Earth Federation!」

stage0007b_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「What's wrong...!
　Too scared of my pressure to speak!?」

stage0007b_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$宗介$$
「I've never met a soldier who runs his mouth in battle.
　Because such a man dies fast.」

stage0007b_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「This guy...!
　Trying to make me angry!」

stage0007b_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$n
「That guy... his movements and reactions
　are nothing like any enemy I've fought before...!」

stage0007b_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Of course!
　Because you're facing a Newtype!」

stage0007b_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$n
「I have no interest in your title.」

stage0007b_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$n
「No matter who I'm up against,
　I just fight the enemy in front of me!」

stage0007b_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Londo Bell, $$ミスリル$$,
　the Frontier fleet's $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, and Super Robots...
　No shortage of opponents!」

stage0007b_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Watch closely...!
　I'll show them all what I'm really made of!」
